prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [141].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格 [141] 的單字或句子。

options.text: The technician checks in each team before the board goes up.
options.zh: 登記板掛出來前，技術員會逐隊報到。
options.whyZh: 登記板已指定位置，不涉及掛板前的逐隊報到。

options.text: Please erase any line that shows your team has canceled the session.
options.zh: 請把所有顯示你的團隊已取消測試的列擦掉。
options.whyZh: 上句明確說不要擦掉整列，否則無法查原櫃號。

options.text: Cabinet numbers may be reused on other teams’ lines after the table is switched off.
options.zh: 振動台關掉後，其他團隊可以在自己的列上重複使用這些櫃號。
options.whyZh: 未規定關機後可借用別隊的櫃號，原號反而需要留存追蹤。

options.text: Keep that number legible even though the booking has been canceled.
options.zh: 即使已取消預約，也要確保櫃號仍看得清楚。
options.whyZh: that number 回指劃掉的櫃號；它仍須可讀，才方便把測試件放回原位並在櫃號旁打勾。

evidence: the technician uses the crossed-out cabinet number to check where to put the pieces back. [insert] Once the pieces are back in the cabinet, she will place a small check mark next to the crossed-out number.
explanationZh: that number 回指劃掉的櫃號；它仍須可讀，才方便把測試件放回原位並在櫃號旁打勾。
